objective: Exercise the accepted ED-to-ward-to-community synthetic composition sequentially within one process through generic batch workers and interruption recovery; assert conservation and stable independent stream namespaces.
steps: Model one replication as the existing deterministic synthetic nominal ED run followed by identity binding and the accepted transfer-manager plus minimal ward/community lifecycle; derive an indexed, serializable result containing timing and ownership/claim conservation observations.
Run eight replications at 1, 2 and 4 generic workers with identical base seed; require complete ordered results and byte-identical serialized result lists.

Interrupt a one-worker six-replication batch after completed work with checkpoint interval 1; require checkpoint and partial marker, no completed document, then resume at two workers and compare exactly to uninterrupted baseline.
Pin the existing progression/service/routing namespace tags and prove service/routing draws do not alter progression draws; rerun existing explicit stream noninterference test.

Keep the subsystem composition within one replication callback and process. Assert the completed person's ownership and final community claim/accounting are conserved; do not imply a unified cross-domain event loop or introduce PDES partitioning.

verification.oracle: Composition worker-count/recovery, lifecycle conservation and stable namespace tests execute and pass.
Existing exact stream noninterference and generic logistics worker/recovery contracts remain passing.

acceptance: A fixed synthetic integrated ED-to-ward-to-community batch is identical at 1, 2 and 4 workers.
Interruption leaves resumable checkpoint evidence and no complete output; recovery is exactly equal to an uninterrupted baseline with no duplicate replication identities.
Person ownership, bed/place claims and transfer terminal state conserve one owner and one final occupied destination claim after successful handovers.
Independent pathway namespace tags remain fixed and unrelated service/routing draws do not perturb progression draws.

Hospital boundaries remain logical composition boundaries; tests use one process and batch-worker callback without claiming a shared cross-domain event loop, PDES, clinical validity, production scheduling or stochastic ED calibration.
stop_conditions: Required composition or generic runner API is missing
Output differs across worker count or resume
Source inputs change from the bound hashes
Any edit escapes the listed write paths
